svg.desc: Qualitative strategy example. Reserve a seat depends on Seat finder, which depends on Catalogue, which depends on Hosting. Visibility decreases downward. Evolution moves from Genesis to Commodity. Seat finder has a hypothetical rightward evolution arrow; it is not a forecast backed by research.
